key.name: panel-box
key.summary: Top bar area that holds the indicator

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Indicator position within its top bar area, 0 is first
key.description: Kept as other indicators appear later.

key.name: panel-primary
key.summary: First remaining percentage shown in the panel, or none

key.name: panel-secondary
key.summary: Second remaining percentage shown in the panel, or none

key.name: panel-reset
key.summary: Time until reset shown in the panel: session, weekly, both, or none

key.name: panel-icon
key.summary: Panel icon color: Claude orange, the panel foreground, or hidden

key.name: show-used
key.summary: Show used capacity instead of remaining capacity
key.description: Applies to the top bar percentages, the menu, and the desktop card. Warning thresholds stay based on remaining capacity.

key.name: show-insights
key.summary: Where to show what contributes to usage over the last day and week

key.name: direct-requests
key.summary: Query the usage endpoint directly instead of through Claude Code
key.description: Claude Code is used whenever it is installed unless this is set. Without Claude Code, usage is always requested directly.

key.name: auto-start-session
key.summary: Start the five-hour session window automatically
key.description: When no session window is running, sends a short prompt through Claude Code so the next window starts counting right away.

key.name: auto-start-model
key.summary: Claude Code model alias used to start a session

key.name: show-session-switch
key.summary: Show a switch for automatic session start in the panel indicator's right-click menu
